reading.body:
Lovo offers a single product, Genny, focused on voice cloning and synthesis for commercial voiceover use, with explicit attention to likeness consent and synthetic media disclosure.

The data covers only the product category and its noted features. It does not include user numbers, pricing, model architecture, training data scale, or infrastructure details. No connection to compute demand, power consumption, or data center footprint can be drawn from what is here.

What the notes do indicate is that Lovo has built disclosure and consent handling into its product description, which places it among voice AI providers that treat provenance and authorization as explicit product concerns rather than afterthoughts. The data does not say how those mechanisms work or whether they satisfy any particular regulatory standard.
